projects.title: Medical Image Saliency Benchmark
projects.description: Benchmarking explanation methods for CNNs in medical vision. This project evaluates different saliency methods for understanding how neural networks make decisions in medical image analysis.

projects.title: Semantic Similarity Research
projects.description: Exploring semantic similarity retrieval methods maximizing BLEU score. Advanced NLP techniques for measuring and improving semantic understanding in text.

projects.title: Wordle Solver
projects.description: Super efficient algorithm for solving generalized Wordle puzzles. Implements optimal guessing strategies using information theory and probability.

projects.title: Diffusion LLMs
projects.description: Research on novel diffusion-based architectures for large language models. Exploring more efficient text generation through length prediction mechanisms.

projects.description: This website! A minimal, clean design built from scratch with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features dark/light mode and responsive design.
